purpose: Historical size and full-verification tradeoff in ADR 0011; not a current performance claim or a complete reproduction kit.

source.scope: Historical full-kernel indexed selection; the source tree and generated indexes are not bundled here.

products.blocks_layout: Ordinary rowid names table with separate primary-key index, schema 5
products.limitation: The archived report identifies source revisions and the changed file but does not provide executable SHA-256 values or source snapshots in this public evidence set.

sampling: Warm-cache runs; six alternating --verify -d samples per platform, medians without exclusions. Six index-build samples per product retain sizes and memory. The before-postings rows are historical controls outside the ADR's main-versus-blocks comparison.
provenance: TSV files are byte-exact copies of the original measure-linux-rowid and measure-windows-rowid capture files. This metadata is a curated description, not an original capture. Cold-cache behavior, maximum latency and subsequent revisions are unmeasured here.
